QuestInfo.name: Sealed Knowledge
QuestInfo.0: The Black Wings seem to know nothing about the motivations of the Black Mage.
QuestInfo.1:
#bThe point of creating the Seal Stones was to provide a way to turn back the clock if anything bad happened.#k When the heroes discovered the Black Mage's plans to destroy Maple World, they set about to create the Seal Stones to stop him. 

#p1404000# didn't seem to know about the Black Mage's plans to destroy the world. Maybe the Black Wings are just being used.

Either way, the Seal Stone of Victoria Island is not safe. It would be best to hurry back to #b#p1002104##k with the news!
QuestInfo.2: You told #p1002104# everything you learned from #p1404000#.

0.0: The Black Mage doesn't share power. Fools. He only wants to bring about the #rend of Maple World#k.
0.1: But what would they want with the Seal Stone? #bIt has the power to turn back time#k, but it wouldn't help them destroy anything. #bIt's just a safety net in case we couldn't stop the Black Mage#k. It's not even a very good one...
0.2: Orchid has know about it, or else... #rthe Black Wings themselves are being used#k?

yes.0: If the Black Wings think they need the Seal Stones to bring back the Black Mage, they're going to be going after the Seal Stone of Victoria Island. If they already know where it is, #b#p1002104##k may be in danger.\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: I shouldn't jump to any conclusions at this point. It could be something outside of my scope right now.

1.0: You sure came back in a jiffy. I don't know why I was worried. #o9300500# is a pushover. \r\n#L0##bYour information was a big help. I found out a lot from #p1404000#, after a little bit of rough-housing. I came back to see if you had the Seal Stone of Victoria Island.#l\n#k
1.1: Of course not. #bI gave that to #p1404002# to give to Rien#k. I bet #p1404001# has it by now. Why do you ask? \r\n#L0##bAccording to #p1404000#, the Black Wings are going after the stone. Rien could be in danger.#l\n#k
1.3: I'll take care of it. #p1404002# and #p1404001# should be there. That island's probably the safest place in the world right now.

yes.0: #bI'll let you know if I need help again.#k

1.2: Rien isn't too far from here, but the currents aren't navigable without help from the penguins. Don't worry, I'll work something out and get in touch with Rien.\r\n#L0##bDo you need help?#l\n#k
